cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm blowing on mine like you. Stay until the tea's cool, at least.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was blowing a tea leaf off the rim. Yours has been cold for ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, clearing the rim. Then stay until we've finished drinking it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can sit for five minutes, but I don't want any more tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the cups. Five minutes with you not reaching for your coat will cool things down enough for me.

reason: Replace the generic confidence prefaces with a specific misunderstood copied action whose correction shapes the Drive, keeping each alternative a different negotiation with B.
